topic: The first widely used high-level programming language
core_question: What was the first widely used high-level programming language, developed by IBM in the 1950s?
answer_summary: Accept 'FORTRAN' (Formula Translation) — released by IBM in 1957, generally cited as the first widely used high-level programming language.
